fr_html: Comme le disait M. Léon Bourgeois, en ouvrant, le 16 juin, les travaux du Comité: „Cette Cour permanente ne sera pas une Cour d'arbitrage, mais une Cour de justice.”
en_html: As M. Léon Bourgeois said in his opening speech at the commencement of the Committee's labours, on the 16th June: This Permanent Court will not be a Court of arbitration, but a Court of justice.
